review_locator: PMCID:PMC7799025, The role of STAT3 in IL-6 signaling; PMCID:PMC3876425, SOCS proteins in cytokine signaling
primary_title: SOCS-3, a potential mediator of interleukin-6-dependent insulin resistance in hepatocytes; STAT3-mediated regulation of SOCS3 expression
decision_basis: The review-guided primary studies show IL-6-induced SOCS3 transcript/protein expression in hepatocytes and STAT3-dependent Socs3 induction in murine fibroblast systems.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-6-associated SOCS3 gene-expression bridge; preserve hepatocyte/fibroblast and STAT3-dependent contexts and do not infer a universal direct transcription mechanism or SCI relevance.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7799025, The role of STAT3 in IL-6 signaling; PMCID:PMC1174965, SOCS proteins and cytokine signaling
primary_title: Expression of suppressors of cytokine signaling during liver regeneration
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-6 administration induces Socs1 mRNA together with other SOCS family transcripts during mouse liver regeneration, with IL-6-deficient comparisons supporting cytokine dependence.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-6-associated SOCS1 gene-expression bridge in the liver-regeneration model; preserve the multi-SOCS induction and do not infer SOCS1-specific STAT3 necessity or SCI relevance.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5241233, G-CSF receptor signaling and SOCS regulation
primary_title: SOCS3 is a critical regulator of G-CSF-induced signaling; Tyrosine 729 of the G-CSF receptor controls duration of granulocyte colony-stimulating factor-induced signaling
decision_basis: The review-guided primary studies show G-CSF rapidly induces SOCS3 expression/transcripts in myeloid systems, with G-CSFR Y729 controlling the duration of cytokine signaling.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded G-CSF-associated SOCS3 gene-expression feedback bridge; preserve myeloid context and CSF3R Y729 duration-control caveat, with no direct receptor-docking or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC5241233, G-CSF receptor signaling and SOCS regulation
primary_title: Tyrosine 729 of the G-CSF receptor controls duration of granulocyte colony-stimulating factor-induced signaling
decision_basis: The review-guided primary reports rapid G-CSF-induced SOCS1 transcript upregulation in myeloid cells as part of the receptor-signaling feedback response.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded G-CSF-associated SOCS1 gene-expression feedback bridge; preserve the myeloid and receptor-mutant context and do not infer direct pY729-SOCS1 binding, terminal transcription, or SCI relevance.
